name: chrome-controlla
description: Control explicitly selected Chrome tabs through Controlla's compact local MCP server with guarded actions and verification.

interface.longDescription: Use Controlla's local MCP server to discover and explicitly pair Chrome tabs, inspect compact semantic state, perform guarded browser actions, and verify mutations without exposing a remote browser endpoint.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Chrome Controlla to work in my explicitly selected Chrome tabs. Prefer semantic snapshots and bounded workflows, verify mutations, and never blindly retry an unknown browser outcome.
